reason: JSON-EX worked-example deletion. The pre-rewrite prompt closed with a # Example block that showed a free-form raw file writer call. That contract is intentionally removed: formatter agents now inspect saved source-backed artifacts, build/validate/preview a projection plan, and call finalize_and_save exactly once. The old example would teach model-authored JSON/file bytes, so it has no home and is deleted rather than relocated.

phrase: After a successful `finalize_and_save`, respond only with a brief ready confirmation.
reason: ALL-1496 formatter stop rule. A successful finalize now ends the formatter run, so the model never writes a reply after it. The runtime file handoff, not a confirmation, carries the saved file to the supervisor. The line is replaced by a statement that a successful finalize ends the run; the no-invented-URL rule and the cannot-complete and failed-finalize guidance are unchanged.
